name: AUTH-REVOKED-OUTBOX
status: Historical G4 candidate: no Stream relay or consumer existed at that stage. Current producer and delivery contract: auth-revoked-stream-v1.json and session-revoked-v2.schema.json; real Agent and business consumers remain pending.

event.eventId: stable UUID generated with sid intent

state: intent PENDING -> REVOKED and separate outbox PENDING inserted atomically after Redis deletion; PENDING does not mean delivered
retry: bounded scan, per-sid expiring lease, retry counter and exponential delay capped at 300 seconds; one failure does not prevent remaining batch
revocation: same sid logout retry allowed while session remains valid; non-logout PENDING requests return 503; delete is idempotent
metrics: protected GET /api/admin/ops/revocations/metrics; persisted counts plus process-local success/failure counters
rollout: G3 tokens without SQL sid records must be invalidated by a separately approved key retirement or allowed to expire before cutover
integration: Historical G4 relay requirement: use the original eventId on redelivery and establish lease/retry/ACK. The current relay contract is auth-revoked-stream-v1.json; downstream Agent pause is not claimed.
historical_gap: G3 intents already marked REVOKED are not automatically copied into the new outbox; a separately approved backfill/replay plan is required.
